notes:
Summary: Mid-market analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood hosted -> Dedicated VPC. Team: Product+Infra (CTO Tom Huang), Head of Data Science (Lena Park). Primary ask is production-ready chat/search embeddings with predictable cost and strict residency controls.

POC / Technical requirements (shorthand):
- Workloads: chat assist for product support, embeddings for doc-search, reranking for search results.
- Latency SLO: 95p < 200ms for short-turn chat (prompt+response), tail concerns for large contexts.
- Throughput target: steady 100-150 reqs/sec during business hours; spikes to 400 reqs/sec for weekly reports.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — care about per-token economics; want quantization recommendations and batching guidance.
- Models: prefer open weights / smaller float16 quantized variants where quality acceptable; fallback to larger model for high-quality answers. Routing: prefer routing by latency then cost.

Security / Compliance asks (from security review):
- SOC2 Type II evidence required for Dedicated offering.
- SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning for IdP (Okta).
- Audit logging: immutable logs, 12 month retention minimum, export to customer SIEM.
- KMS integration for tenant keys, HSM optional.
- Data residency: US + EU region options, legal needs explicit data flow diagrams.
- Retention controls: ability to configure retention policy per dataset and purge on request.

Meetings / interactions (notes):
- 2024-11-20: initial intro call (AE Maya) — product fit confirmed; they use embeddings heavily.
- 2024-12-05: Hosted API demo (Diego) — ran sample chat + embedding flow; good initial perf. Fireflies: ff_20241205_9a3b.
- 2025-01-08: Pricing deep-dive + reserved capacity options; asked for committed vs burst pricing.
- 2025-01-18: POC kickoff (small bench tests) — dataset + test prompts provided; infra contacted for VPC pre-check. Fireflies: ff_20250118_4f7e.
- 2025-01-28: Security questionnaire submitted; follow-up requested for SOC2 artifacts and networking diagram.
- 2025-02-01: SE call with infra to discuss VPC peering requirements (Diego + Oakbridge infra).

Stated quotes / customer sentiment (snippets):

POC details & success criteria:
- Baseline: Hosted API run to validate latency and quality (done).
- Next: Dedicated VPC pilot for 2 weeks with 2 nodes, KV/prefix caching enabled, telemetry to their SIEM. Success = <200ms p95 and cost per session within 1.5x hosted baseline.

Docs sent: Redwood Dedicated pricing v2, security FAQ, sample VPC diagram (drive links above).
